content_zh:
她还没怕过谁。
这是非要怼上的意思？
博九看着那道危险无比背影，甩了甩自己略微有些发疼的手腕。
阳光透过树叶洒落在他的身上，就像是万丈光芒加身一样，除了尊贵就是奢华。
单单只是错过的气息都会让人觉得冰寒无比。
再加上他身后跟着的一大票的黑衣保镖。
看来，以后真的是有点麻烦了…
************
学校的领导们怎么也没有想到秦少就这么容易的放过了这个博九，连过问都没有过问，错愕的同时纷纷松了一口气。
“幸好秦少为人大度。“
”谁说不是。“
教导主任虚惊一场的擦了擦额上的汗。
只有喵系少年歪头又咬了一下自己怀里的兔子耳朵，他认识的队长向来都是睚眦必报，他越是当下不发火，后果就会越严重……
刚刚那个扑过来的博九，这一下真的是死定了！
秦漠走在最前面，胸前仿佛还残留着那从来都没有过的触感，这让他的眸光陷入了前所未有的深沉。
不过是短短一分钟，学校的师生们却觉得过了好久好久。
直到秦漠的背影彻底消失之后，陈晓东才宛如狂风一样朝着博九卷了过来，那双眼睛都瞪大了：“少爷，你知不知道你刚才在做什么？这件事如果被老板知道，又该骂你了，还有秦少那边，他向来不喜欢别人碰他，你这是在挑战他的底线吗？还在那撩了他一把。少爷，秦少和你不一样，他真的不是弯的！”
博九把手插进口袋，很酷的否认：“我也不是弯的。”
“你都对秦少这样那样了，你……”陈晓东说到这里，叹了一口气：“少爷，我知道，如果我是弯的，也会喜欢上秦少那样的男人，但是你看看周围这些女孩子都没有像你一样，直接扑上去抱人家。”
博九喔了一声，态度实在漫不经心的很，嘴角还半弯着：“你这样说，那个秦少的初抱岂不是都给了我。“

“少爷……“陈晓东真的是被自家少爷打败了，这都什么时候了，还在想这个。
博九拍了拍他的肩：“逗你的，不过我要声明一下，我没想冲过去抱谁，刚刚在低头想去电脑城的事，措不及防的被人从后面推了一把。“
“我相信你！“陈晓东无比认真！
博九挑了下眉。
陈晓东继续道：“所以少爷，我们彼此真诚点，下次你再想对秦少做什么，先告诉我！”
博九：……
给读者的话：１号才开始四更和定点更，美人们，欢迎来校草打卡，么么哒。
喜欢国民校草是女生请大家
content_en:
She has never been afraid of anyone.
Does this mean you have to fight?
Bo Jiu looked at the extremely dangerous figure and shook his slightly aching wrist.
The sun shone through the leaves and fell on his body, like a ray of light shining on him. In addition to being noble, it was luxurious.
Just missing the breath will make people feel extremely cold.
Plus he was followed by a large number of bodyguards in black.
It seems that it will really be a bit troublesome in the future...
************
The school leaders never thought that Master Qin would let Bo Jiu go so easily without even asking. They were shocked and at the same time breathed a sigh of relief.
"Fortunately, Mr. Qin is a generous man."
"Who says otherwise."
The dean of teachers wiped the sweat from his forehead in false alarm.
Only the meow-type boy tilted his head and bit the rabbit ear in his arms. The captain he knew was always retributive. The more he didn't get angry at the moment, the more serious the consequences would be...
Bo Jiu, who just jumped at him, is really dead now!
Qin Mo walked in the front, and there seemed to be a touch that he had never experienced before, which made his eyes sink deeper than ever before.
It was just a minute, but the teachers and students at the school felt that a long time had passed.
It wasn't until Qin Mo's back completely disappeared that Chen Xiaodong rolled towards Bo Jiu like a strong wind, his eyes widened: "Master, do you know what you were doing just now? If the boss finds out about this, he will scold you again, and Master Qin, he never likes others to touch him, are you challenging his bottom line? You even teased him there. Master, Master Qin is different from you, he is really not a crook!"
Bo Jiu put his hands in his pockets and denied it coolly: "I'm not bent either."
"You have done this and that to Young Master Qin, you..." Chen Xiaodong said this and sighed: "Master, I know that if I were a bender, I would also like a man like Young Master Qin, but look at the girls around you, none of them jump directly to hug others like you."
Bo Jiu groaned, his attitude was really nonchalant, and the corners of his mouth were still half-curved: "If you put it this way, didn't that Young Master Qin give me his first hug?"
"Master..." Chen Xiaodong was really defeated by his young master. How long has it been? I'm still thinking about this.
Bo Jiu patted him on the shoulder: "I'm kidding you, but I want to make it clear that I didn't want to rush over to hug anyone. I just lowered my head to go to the Computer City and was pushed from behind by someone unprepared."
"I believe you!" Chen Xiaodong is extremely serious!
Bo Jiu raised his eyebrows.
Chen Xiaodong continued: "So Master, let's be sincere to each other. Next time you want to do anything to Master Qin, tell me first!"
Bo Jiu:......
